purpose: Completion switches prioritize avoiding false confirmation; calibrate a usable operating point rather than optimize overall accuracy alone.
method: Restricted true/false next-token probability after a shared JSON prefix; no second model or simulator inputs.
selection_data: Full validation initial-state-1 episodes only; no test scores or labels select thresholds.
selection_rule: Maximize validation true-positive rate under the limit; ties prefer lower false-positive rate then higher threshold.
comparison: Calibrate base and selected LoRA identically; retain original greedy results separately.
test: All 240 initial-state-2 cases, including boundary challenge; no weight or threshold changes after test scoring.
